# Purpose

This document implements the stratified random sample from the simulated population of 10,000 Wits University students. It uses the Section B Neyman allocation, adds year of study as an auxiliary variable, calculates inclusion probabilities and design weights, checks the realised sample, and saves the required CSV files.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

# 1. Load and verify the finite population

Place `wits_printing_population.csv` in the same RCloud working directory as this RMD.

```{r load}
population <- read.csv("wits_printing_population.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(population) == 10000)
needed <- c("student_id","faculty","pages_month")
if (!all(needed %in% names(population))) stop("Required population variables are missing.")
cat("Population size:", nrow(population), "\n")
head(population)
```

# 2. Add an auxiliary variable

Year of study is included as a relevant auxiliary variable. The probabilities are simulation assumptions, not actual Wits enrolment proportions.

```{r auxiliary}
set.seed(4103)
year_levels <- c("First year","Second year","Third year","Fourth year or above")
year_probs <- c(0.30,0.27,0.24,0.19)
population$year_of_study <- sample(year_levels, nrow(population),
                                   replace=TRUE, prob=year_probs)
table(population$year_of_study)
```

# 3. Define the Section B Neyman allocation

The minimum completed sample was 372. After allowing for 10% anticipated non-response, 414 students are selected initially.

```{r allocation}
allocation <- data.frame(
 faculty=c("Commerce, Law and Management",
           "Engineering and the Built Environment",
           "Health Sciences","Humanities","Science"),
 N_h=c(2500,2000,1700,2300,1500),
 n_h=c(97,55,77,138,47),
 stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
allocation$inclusion_probability <- allocation$n_h/allocation$N_h
allocation$sampling_weight <- allocation$N_h/allocation$n_h
allocation
cat("Total sample:", sum(allocation$n_h), "\n")
```

# 4. Verify faculty population sizes

```{r faculty-check}
obs <- as.data.frame(table(population$faculty))
names(obs) <- c("faculty","observed_N_h")
check <- merge(allocation[,c("faculty","N_h")], obs, by="faculty", all.x=TRUE)
print(check)
stopifnot(all(check$N_h == check$observed_N_h))
```

# 5. Draw the stratified sample

Sampling is without replacement within each faculty. Seed 4104 makes the realised sample reproducible.

```{r draw}
set.seed(4104)
sample_list <- vector("list", nrow(allocation))

for (h in seq_len(nrow(allocation))) {
  f <- allocation$faculty[h]
  d <- population[population$faculty == f, ]
  idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), size=allocation$n_h[h], replace=FALSE)
  s <- d[idx, ]
  s$N_h <- allocation$N_h[h]
  s$n_h <- allocation$n_h[h]
  s$inclusion_probability <- allocation$inclusion_probability[h]
  s$sampling_weight <- allocation$sampling_weight[h]
  sample_list[[h]] <- s
}

sample_data <- do.call(rbind, sample_list)
rownames(sample_data) <- NULL
sample_data <- sample_data[,c("student_id","faculty","year_of_study",
                              "pages_month","N_h","n_h",
                              "inclusion_probability","sampling_weight")]
cat("Realised sample size:", nrow(sample_data), "\n")
head(sample_data,10)
```

# 6. Verify the realised allocation

```{r realised-check}
realised <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data$faculty))
names(realised) <- c("faculty","realised_n")
allocation_check <- merge(allocation[,c("faculty","n_h")], realised, by="faculty")
print(allocation_check)
stopifnot(all(allocation_check$n_h == allocation_check$realised_n))
stopifnot(nrow(sample_data) == 414)
```

# 7. Data-quality and design checks

```{r checks}
duplicates <- sum(duplicated(sample_data$student_id))
missing <- sum(is.na(sample_data))
negative <- sum(sample_data$pages_month < 0)
invalid_pi <- sum(sample_data$inclusion_probability <= 0 |
                  sample_data$inclusion_probability > 1)
weight_error <- max(abs(sample_data$sampling_weight -
                        1/sample_data$inclusion_probability))

cat("Duplicate IDs:", duplicates, "\n")
cat("Missing values:", missing, "\n")
cat("Negative page counts:", negative, "\n")
cat("Invalid inclusion probabilities:", invalid_pi, "\n")
cat("Maximum weight identity error:", weight_error, "\n")

stopifnot(duplicates == 0, missing == 0, negative == 0,
          invalid_pi == 0, weight_error < 1e-10)
```

# 8. Summary of the realised sample

```{r summary}
faculty_n <- aggregate(pages_month ~ faculty, sample_data, length)
names(faculty_n)[2] <- "sample_n"
faculty_mean <- aggregate(pages_month ~ faculty, sample_data, mean)
names(faculty_mean)[2] <- "sample_mean"
faculty_sd <- aggregate(pages_month ~ faculty, sample_data, sd)
names(faculty_sd)[2] <- "sample_sd"

realised_summary <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x,y,by="faculty"),
                           list(faculty_n,faculty_mean,faculty_sd))
realised_summary$sample_mean <- round(realised_summary$sample_mean,2)
realised_summary$sample_sd <- round(realised_summary$sample_sd,2)
realised_summary

cat("Overall unweighted sample mean:",
    round(mean(sample_data$pages_month),2), "pages\n")
```

# 9. Auxiliary-variable summary

```{r year-summary}
year_summary <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data$year_of_study))
names(year_summary) <- c("year_of_study","sample_n")
year_summary$percentage <- round(100*year_summary$sample_n/nrow(sample_data),1)
year_summary
```

# 10. Plots

```{r histogram, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
hist(sample_data$pages_month, breaks=30,
     main="Monthly Printing and Photocopying Demand in the Realised Sample",
     xlab="Number of pages per month", ylab="Number of sampled students")
```

```{r boxplot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
boxplot(pages_month ~ faculty, data=sample_data, las=2,
        main="Monthly Printing and Photocopying Demand by Faculty",
        xlab="Faculty", ylab="Pages per month")
```

# 11. Save required files

```{r save}
write.csv(population, "wits_printing_population_with_auxiliary.csv", row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(sample_data, "wits_printing_sample.csv", row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(realised_summary, "section_C_realised_sample_summary.csv", row.names=FALSE)

```
